job.prompt: Edit this exact 1536x1024 pixel-art WWII game background into a clean STATIC ENVIRONMENT BASE. Preserve its resolution, camera, pixel-art style, terrain, mountains, buildings, destroyed roofs, trenches, craters, scorched earth, objects and exact flat gameplay-ground boundary. Remove ALL people everywhere, including tiny distant lookouts, sentries, seated civilians, silhouettes, faces in windows and soldiers at gun positions: fill their places naturally with the existing unoccupied environment. Remove ALL fabric flags, cloth banners, pennants and their poles; painted red stars on masonry may stay because they are fixed paint. Remove all sky cloud shapes, retaining the original smooth blue/gray sky palette; clouds will be animated separately if wanted. Do not add any moving creatures, birds, animals, people, moving vehicles, cloth, fires, smoke or floating dust. Empty sandbag posts and shelters may remain, with no occupants. Preserve all wartime ground damage and open space; do not beautify the scene or turn damaged fields into a pristine lawn. Keep all remaining environment geometry in the same place, especially the lower combat strip: no layout redesign, no new objects, no text, no grid, no borders. For a river scene keep the river's exact geometry and color, but simplify it to calm flat water without white ripples or frozen waves, for a separately animated overlay. Return the complete full-resolution background, not a cutout.
